page.overview:
What is Judicial Ship?

The Judicial Ship was a traveling court that can judge a person anywhere in the world. It carried Jorge to sentence Tom to death in Enies Lobby. It was later destroyed by Spandam using the Battle Frankies as part of his plot against Tom.

The vessel was a large brown ship, with a similarly large courtroom within it. On the outside, there was a structure similar to the entrance to Enies Lobby. The ship had three large sails and flew the World Government flag on top of the crow's nest.

The ship came to judge Tom, but he was given a ten-year extension on his sentencing by Jorge in order to build the Sea Train. After the ten years were up, the ship was destroyed by Spandam who used Franky's Battle Frankies to blow it up, who pinned the blame on Tom and got him sentenced to death.
